project: Gore-Kang Alternate History — Kang Administration Second Term
scope_note: Strategic roadmap and major events for the second term of President Will Kang (2013-2017).

key_pillars: Interplanetary Logistics (Mars Colonial Transporter & Asteroid ISRU)

timeline_major_events.impact: Leveraging the NCD-YBCO-12 high-temperature superconductor discovered via Project Meissner, President Kang officially breaks ground on the Cascadia Maglev line connecting Eugene, Portland, Seattle, and Vancouver.
timeline_major_events.outcome: Upgrades the planned Phase 2 High-Speed Rail corridor to a true frictionless magnetic levitation system. This marks the first massive commercial deployment of the AI-discovered superconductors, drastically reducing travel times on the West Coast and showcasing the immediate, tangible benefits of the administration's sovereign compute investments.

timeline_major_events.impact: The NASA Launch Services Directorate (SpaceX Division) successfully launches the Prospector-1 probe atop a Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral. The spacecraft deploys its solar arrays and fires its Hall-effect thrusters, beginning its deep-space cruise to rendezvous with NEO 2011-CH ('Chrysalis').
timeline_major_events.outcome: Marks the operational commencement of Project Hephaestus. The mission aims to ground-truth the presence of extractable water ice and platinum-group metals, laying the physical groundwork for the trillion-dollar asteroid mining architecture.

timeline_major_events.event: Operation 'Quiet Wire': DOJ Dismantles Neo-Luddite Network
timeline_major_events.impact: Attorney General Barack Obama announces a massive civil RICO indictment against a coordinated Neo-Luddite network in the Pacific Northwest. Using WTP2 authority, the DOJ links physical saboteurs attacking GridSmart substations directly to the dark-money PACs and local politicians funding and inciting them.
timeline_major_events.outcome: Instead of a militarized standoff, the DOJ treats the domestic insurgency as a financial fraud enterprise. By freezing their assets and burying their leadership in federal court proceedings, Obama effectively bankrupts the movement, turning a hoped-for 'Second Civil War' into an unglamorous bureaucratic defeat.

timeline_major_events.impact: The expanded 13-member Supreme Court overwhelmingly rejects appeals from Neo-Luddite funders attempting to overturn AG Obama's WTP2 civil RICO asset freezes. Citing the mandatory 72-hour judicial review safeguard in the statutes, the Court rules that due process was fully satisfied.
timeline_major_events.outcome: Legally validates the administration's method of bankrupting domestic insurgencies via forensic accounting. The remnant realizes the courts will not save them, cementing their total financial and political isolation.

timeline_major_events.event: Americas Integrity Partnership: The First Tranche Release
timeline_major_events.impact: The Joint Commission on Regional Integrity and Development formally certifies that Costa Rica, Panama, and the Dominican Republic have successfully completed their Phase 1 public procurement digitization and beneficial ownership registries.
timeline_major_events.outcome: Secretary of State Hillary Clinton authorizes the immediate release of 'Tranche 2' development finance and targeted tariff relief. The highly visible rollout of subsidized AmeriSat terminals to regional schools and clinics creates a powerful demonstration effect, putting immense pressure on neighboring 'Violence and Capture Track' states (like Honduras and Guatemala) to root out elite corruption or risk falling permanently behind.

timeline_major_events.event: Prospector-1 Anchors at Chrysalis: The Water Strike
timeline_major_events.impact: Following its deep-space cruise and a 90-day orbital mapping phase, the Prospector-1 probe successfully executes an autonomous 'Touch and Anchor' maneuver on NEO 2011-CH ('Chrysalis'). The probe's Deep Core Drill extracts subsurface regolith, and onboard mass spectrometers confirm massive, easily extractable concentrations of water ice alongside platinum-group metals.
timeline_major_events.outcome: The discovery of the 'Holy Grail' of asteroid compositions—providing both high-value metals and the water necessary to synthesize local propellant—fully validates the Project Hephaestus architecture. NASA immediately greenlights Phase 2: the deployment of the Earth-Moon L2 'Mass Catcher'.

timeline_major_events.event: The L2 Access Framework: Global Space Reaction
timeline_major_events.impact: To preempt fears of a U.S. monopoly over deep-space propellant, the administration formally hands regulatory and market-access oversight of the planned Earth-Moon L2 Mass Catcher to the Global Space Authority (GSA). Assured of neutral, transparent access, ESA, JAXA, and China formally align their future spacecraft architectures to integrate with the new logistics hub.
timeline_major_events.outcome: By intentionally refusing to become the 'OPEC of space', the U.S. successfully de-escalates geopolitical tensions. The GSA's guarantee of open market access to asteroid-derived resources cements the cooperative G2 framework in deep space, channeling Chinese and European investments into a shared 'Cis-Lunar Commons' rather than a fragmented logistical arms race.

timeline_major_events.impact: Following the successful de-escalation of the L2 Mass Catcher dispute, President Kang and Chinese leadership meet to formally reaffirm their terrestrial G2 commitments, safeguarding the Beijing Protocol and Formosa Neutrality Doctrine.
timeline_major_events.outcome: The G2 partnership is preserved on Earth. The U.S. and China successfully navigate the transition into the post-scarcity space economy without fracturing the global supply chain, proving the 'Architecture of Peace' can withstand profound technological disruption.

timeline_major_events.impact: The Oak Ridge Prometheus-1 reactor officially achieves net-positive energy ignition (Q>1). The National Compute Directorate's AI seamlessly stabilizes the 'burning plasma', delivering the first continuous commercial-scale fusion power to the GridSmart network. Secretary Clinton immediately initiates the 'Prometheus Pact' for U.S. allies.
timeline_major_events.outcome: Baseload fossil fuels become permanently obsolete. The U.S. offers reactor export licenses strictly conditioned on WTP-transparency and the Beijing Protocol. Because the U.S. NCD retains the sovereign AI required to stabilize the plasma, Washington secures a literal 'kill switch' over allied energy grids, achieving unassailable geopolitical hegemony.

timeline_major_events.impact: As the global oil crash devastates its economy, Pakistan faces imminent state failure. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton brokers the 'Islamabad Accord', placing the nation under a managed economic receivership funded by the U.S. and IMF. The massive bailout, which includes domestic desalinization and AmeriSat infrastructure, is strictly conditioned on placing Pakistan's nuclear arsenal under comprehensive joint monitoring by the IAEA and the Global Space Authority (GSA).
timeline_major_events.outcome: The administration successfully defuses a catastrophic nuclear security crisis without military intervention. By leveraging its post-scarcity economic power and the neutral oversight of the GSA, the U.S. expands the 'Architecture of Peace' into South Asia, though it requires delicate proxy-management with an anxious China.

timeline_major_events.impact: On Earth Day 2016, Germany becomes the first major European power to formally sign the Prometheus Pact. Desperate to permanently decouple its massive industrial sector from residual Russian natural gas influence, Berlin agrees to WTP-style transparency and accepts the U.S. NCD's 'Sovereign Air-Gap' AI control over its new 'Builder's Reactors'.
timeline_major_events.outcome: The ultimate triumph of the 'Helsinki-Kyiv Compact'. Germany's capitulation to U.S. energy hegemony sets off a domino effect across Europe. Allied nations scramble to sign the pact to keep their manufacturing sectors competitive, perfectly setting the stage for Hillary Clinton's 'Global Builder Initiative' presidential campaign.

timeline_major_events.impact: The administration connects the first cluster of domestic 'Builder's Reactors' to the national GridSmart network. Paired with Project Meissner's high-temperature superconductors, the deployment effectively eliminates electricity transmission losses, causing utility bills in connected regions to plummet to near-zero.
timeline_major_events.outcome: The tangible reality of free, clean energy cements overwhelming popular support for the 'Builder' agenda heading into the 2016 election. In response, the 'Anti-System' remnant radicalizes further into the 'Diesel Rebellion', actively urging their base to disconnect from the 'Sovereign Power' grid and rely on expensive fossil fuels as a symbol of political resistance.

key_speeches.speaker: President Will Kang
key_speeches.context: Oval Office Address following the Prospector-1 'Water Strike' on Chrysalis (July 20, 2015)
key_speeches.title: The First Interplanetary Supply Chain
key_speeches.summary: President Kang announces the discovery of water ice and platinum-group metals on NEO 2011-CH by the Prospector-1 probe. He frames the discovery as the end of the terrestrial gravity well bottleneck and officially greenlights Phase 2 of Project Hephaestus.
key_speeches.transcript_excerpt: We have found the Holy Grail of deep space exploration... Because of the success of Prospector-1, we no longer have to drag all our building materials up from the bottom of Earth's gravity well. Chrysalis is not just a rock floating in the dark. As of this morning, it is the first gas station and steel mill on the interplanetary highway. We have solved the physics. Now, it is simply a manufacturing project. And nobody manufactures like the United States.
